description: Line items store a price snapshot that can differ from the product's current price.
detection_hint: Join order_items.sku to products and compare unit_list_price with list_price.
Fuzzy-match on last_name + zip_code + email_domain; first names differ by nickname.

description: ~1.5% of customers have a city that does not match their state/zip.
detection_hint: Validate city against state with a zip-to-state lookup; a small share will fail.

description: A small share of state codes are lowercase ('ca' not 'CA').
detection_hint: Check distinct state values for case inconsistency.

description: Some age_band values are the sentinel string 'Unknown'.
detection_hint: Treat 'Unknown' as missing; it will not behave like a numeric or ordered band.

description: ~1.5% are internal/test accounts but the flag catches only ~60%.
detection_hint: Combine the flag with internal email domains and first_name in (Test, QA).

description: customer_segment loosely tracks behaviour but has no stated definition.
detection_hint: Ask what 'Loyal' or 'VIP' means before using it in a metric.

description: Loyalty members are generated to be more active, so they churn less. Association, not cause.
detection_hint: Comparing churn by loyalty invites a causal read the design does not support.

description: order_discount is an order-level promo not allocated to lines, so SUM(line_revenue) != orders.revenue.
detection_hint: revenue equals SUM(line_revenue) - order_discount. Naive line-summing overstates revenue.

description: Three revenue definitions: merchandise (revenue), net of refunds (adjusted_revenue), gross cash incl shipping+tax (gross_collected).
detection_hint: Agree which one the metric means before reporting.

description: ~1% of orders have num_items not equal to their order_items line count (never 0).
detection_hint: Compare num_items to COUNT(order_items) per order_id.

description: Free-shipping threshold dropped from 50 to 35 on 2025-06-15. Bulky items can still pay above it.
detection_hint: RDD on subtotal at the cutoff; DiD on the newly-treated 35-50 band before/after.

description: Mountain received free 2-day shipping on 2025-08-01, lifting orders ~18%.
detection_hint: Synthetic control: treat Mountain, donor pool = other 9 regions, weekly series.

description: ~8% of orders ship to a region different from the customer's home region.
detection_hint: Do not assume ship_to_region equals the customer's region in joins.

description: ~15% of refunded orders have an order-level refund that differs from the line sum.
detection_hint: Most refunds reconcile exactly; a minority carry order-level adjustments.
